name: Fulcrum
classificationNote: Classified by keyword rules from the RevertIQ label and description.
rootCause: On January 11, 2020, Fulcrum released a flash loan feature on Ethereum Mainnet that exposed user funds to exploit risk through an atomic transaction vulnerability. The flaw enabled potential theft of $2.5 million from three pools. A white-hat intervention by 1inch demonstrated the risk before a malicious exploit occurred. The vulnerability originated from the Fulcrum flash loan feature, which failed to account for atomic flash loan manipulation. The system made state-changing decisions on spot balances within a single transaction, allowing the possibility for an attacker to drain pool funds by exploiting flash loans without external price references or delay.
